text: うむ　ざんねん　じゃったのう　じゃが　しかし！

structure.jp: ざんねん　じゃったのう
structure.en: that was a shame, wasn't it

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃった is the old-man form of だった, 'was'. ざんねん　じゃった = 'it was a shame'.

patterns.name: 〜なあ
patterns.explanation: のう is the old-man version of なあ, added at the end to show feeling, here sympathy. ざんねん　じゃったのう = 'that was a shame, wasn't it'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が after a statement means 'but'. じゃが is the old-man form of だが, used to start a sentence. じゃが = 'but'.
